title: Oily Smoky Brazilian Bok Choi Fried Rice
description: A smoky and crumbly Brazilian dish featuring bok choi, perfect for a hangover cure, served in a lacquerware bowl. This high-protein-friendly recipe is made with fry-grind-rice-khao-khua.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced smoked sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped bok choi and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Push the bok choi and sausage mixture to one side of the skillet.
Add a little more oil if necessary, then pour in the beaten eggs and scramble them until cooked through.
Mix the eggs with the bok choi and sausage mixture.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir-fry the rice with the bok choi and egg mixture for about 5 minutes, adding soy sauce to taste.
Serve the fried rice hot in a lacquerware bowl.
